protocol.ligand: Use the same frozen standardized single-component forms and current RDKit/MMFF/Meeko preparation for seeds and all groups.

scoring: First ranked Vina pose; output-minus-same-target-seed delta.
chemical_forms: Unique carbon-containing component; only atomic counterions may be removed. Preserve input formal charge, stereochemistry and isotopes; no neutralization/protonation/tautomer search.
eligibility: All planned positions retained; score every delivered output on the fixed11 targets, no QED/Vina filter.
statistics: Secondary descriptive target-macro means and unadjusted95% target bootstrap intervals; no new superiority tests. Generation S/U tests unchanged.
cache: Only exact task identity, normalized canonical, receptor hash, grid, full protocol hash, identical engine code and checked prepared chemistry/score artifacts.
pilot: One fresh seed reproduction plus first uncached job per T/M/G/R and one direct baseline, fixed before scores; seed reproduction tolerance0.01 kcal/mol.
failures: Keep preparation failures/timeouts with missing scores, no better-score retries; do not impute Vina zero.
